title: Week 3 of AI Trading. Crypto is working well!
author: randbobaccount
selftext:
Last week: https://www.reddit.com/r/ai\_trading/s/7bL2v4jZca

This week the equities agents didn’t do as well leading to lower gains. 

But crypto rotator is here to stay! It’s doubled the money over the past couple of months I’ve been invested in it. Has been timing almost perfect entries and exits for ADA, LINK, and now in ETH! A couple of my friends who use Raijin invested only in crypto so their portfolio is up way bigger than mine and they’ve won the weekly leaderboard prize consistently.

The main equities agents that were positive this week were med related agents that likely caught the Moderna news - bought in at open and exited before it crashed too hard. Besides that just been loving this app to make AI trading accessible for all of us! 🙏

comments.author: Mustapha_Coltrane
comments.body: Are you using the crypto agent on robinhood or coinbase?

replies.body: Coinbase! I connected both Robinhood and Coinbase to Raijin. Soon Robinhood agentic is releasing crypto so won’t need to do both anymore though 😅
